# laravelforge_site_reverb (Data Source)

Fetches the Laravel Reverb integration status for a Forge site.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `organization` (String) Organization slug.
- `server_id` (Number) ID of the server the site belongs to.
- `site_id` (Number) ID of the site.

### Read-Only

- `connections` (Number) Maximum number of concurrent connections.
- `enabled` (String) Whether the Reverb integration is enabled, as reported by Forge.
- `host` (String) Reverb host.
- `port` (Number) Reverb port.
- `reverb_installed` (Boolean) Whether the Reverb package is installed on the site.
